rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING PROVINCIAL GOVERNORS AND CITY MAYORS TO PUBLISH IN A NEWSPAPER OF GENERAL CIRCULATION WITHIN HIS PROVINCE OR CITY A SUMMARY OF ALL REVENUES, COLLECTIONS, INCOME AND PUBLIC FUNDS RECEIVED BY THE PROVINCE OR CITY DURING THE PRECEDINGCALENDAR YEAR AND A SUMMARY OF ALL DISBURSEMENTS, EXPENDITURES AND UTILIZATION OF SUCH FUNDS FOR THE PERIOD
rows.abstract: Declares it a policy to provide greater public information about public funds received by provincial and city governments and the utilization of such funds. Requires all provincial governors and city mayors to publish within sixty days from the endof each year in a newspaper of general circulation within the province once a week for two consecutive weeks, a summary of all revenues, collections, income and public funds received by the province or the city furing the preceeding year and all disbursements, expenditures and utilization of said funds.

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING THE PUBLIC FRANKING PRIVILEGE ON OFFICIAL COMMUNICATIONS MAILED TO NATIONAL AND LOCAL ELECTIVE OFFICIALS IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Provides that all official mails addressed to national and local elective officials from their constituents for delivery within the country, shall be received, transmitted, and delivered in the mails of the country free of postage.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1995-07-27

rows.author: A046
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, ENTITLED, "AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE UNDER A REORGANIZED DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES"
rows.abstract: Makes mandatory the assignment of key uniformed personnel of the Philippine National Police to positions corresponding to their ranks, and that no key uniformed personnel shall be removed from their ranks without just cause, and consigned to a "floating status."
rows.status: Substituted by HB10089

rows.author: A046
rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBER 4374, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "GEODETIC ENGINEERING LAW," AS AMENDED BY PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERS 202 AND 335, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Limits the practice of geodetic engineering works only to graduates of Bachelor of Science in Geodetic Engineering.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07863

rows.author: A046
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE ESTABLISHMENT AND CONDUCT OF CHECKPOINTS
rows.abstract: Establishes and strictly regualtes the conduct of military and/or police checkpoints under exceptional circumstances where the lives of the people are in grave danger.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING BENEFITS FOR DEATHS OR INJURIES SUFFERED BY CIVILIANS IN THE COURSE OF MILITARY OR POLICE OPERATIONS
rows.abstract: Provides material support to innocent civilian victims caught in the crossfire and became casualties during military or police operations in actual combat with rebel elements.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL, POLITICAL AND HUMAN RIGHTS since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING A NEW RATE FOR THE INSTRUCTIONAL AID ALLOWANCES FOR PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS
rows.abstract: Increases the annual allocation for instructional aids and devices for public school teachers from [One HUndred Pesos (P100.00)] to not less than THREE HUNDRED PESOS (P300.00).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT LIBERALIZING THE RULE OF RECIPROCITY IN THE GRANT OF CERTAIN AIR TRAFFIC RIGHTS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Grants more air traffic rights, freedoms and opportunities to countries with established sources of tourist traffic, even beyond what these countries may be willing to grant to the Philippines.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENHANCE THE PROMOTION AND MARKETING OF PHILIPPINE TOURISM AND INTERNATIONAL TRADE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Philippine Tourism and International Trade Reorientation Act of 1995" Creates the Philippine Tourism, Trading and Exports Corporation which shall be solely responsible for the improvement, enhancement, and international marketing of Philippinetourism and for the promotion of foreign-trade and exports-related activities. Creates also within the Deprtment of Foreign Affairs the Bureau of Foreign Trades and Tourism which shall exercise the powers and duties of the Department of Tourism, consequently abolishes the Department of Tourism.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 1995-07-27

first_reading.comm_act: joint ref'l with Special Ctte. on Export Promotion as per J. 11; p. 34; Aug. 13, 1996

rows.title_full: AN ACT LIMITING THE RECOVERY BY A CREDITOR TO THE PROCEEDS OF FORECLOSURE SALE OF THE MORTGAGED PROPERTY AS PAYMENT OF THE PRINCIPAL OBLIGATION AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE TWENTY-HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-SEVEN OF THE CIVIL CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Amends Article 2087 of the Civil Code of the Philippines by adding a restrictive provision inhibiting the creditor from obtaining a deficiency judgement from the debtor in case the proceeds of the thing pledged or mortgaged happens to be less than the amount of obligation due the creditor.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING ALL FRANCHISES TO ESTABLISH, OPERATE, AND MAINTAIN GAMBLING CASINOS FOR FOREIGNERS ONLY, REPEALING FOR THIS PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1869, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The National Franchise Law on Gambling Casinos" Repeals all existing franchises for gambling casinos and allows the issuance of franchises anew as mere support facilities to the tourism industry; allows qualified private coprorations as grantees ofsaid franchises, and; imposes special conditions on the issuance of such franchises in order for them to allow only tourists and foreigners who are at least twenty-one years old as casino players and for these grantees to oeprate only in selected areas.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LEGISLATIVE FRANCHISES since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS A SHARE IN THE LANDING AND TERMINAL FEES COLLECTED BY THE BUREAU OF AIR TRANSPORTATION (BAT), AMENDING SECTION 52, CHAPTER IX OF REPUBLIC ACT NO.776, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CIVIL AERONAUTICS ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Grants a share in the landing and terminal fees collected by the Bureau of Air Transportation (BAT) to locla government units (LGUs) where the government's air navigating facilities are located. Earmarks a portion of the revolving fund of the BAT for the installation and improvement of the runway lights designed to guide pilots during day and night landing.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE GRADUAL IMPLEMETATION OF THE REVISED TAX CEILING ON BUSINESS UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVEN THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED AND SIXTY, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS ONE HUNDRED FORTY-ONE, ONE HUNDRED FORTY- THREE AND ONE HUNDREDFIFTY-ONE THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to put a percentage cap on the tax rate to be increased in proportion to previous tax rates, but still allows subsequent increase once every five years in order to cushion the impact of new rate ceilings under this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE RATIONALIZATION OF THE PROFESSIONAL RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN RESIDENT PHYSICIANS AND PRIVATE HOSPITALS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Resident Physicians' Professionaliza tion Act of 1995" Places the resident physicians of private hospitals under the category of employees as understood under the Labor Code, this, paving the way for a more realistic and raionalized compensation scheme for these long-neglected members of the most valuable profession.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR RELEASE OF THE TOTAL DEATH BENEFITS FOR THE BENEFICIARIES OF ANY GOVERNMENT PERSONNEL WHO DIED WHILE IN LINE OF DUTY WITHIN FIFTEEN DAYS FROM NOTICE OF DEATH
rows.abstract: Seeks to correct the practice of delaying the processing, approval and payment of financial and monetary claims of the surviving families and loved ones of deceased members of the AFP, PNP and the general Civil Service with the concerned governmentagencies.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08561

rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR ANY VIOLATION OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED FORTY-EIGHT HUNDRED FORTY-SIX, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'CULTURAL PROPERTIES PRESERVATION AND PROTECTION ACT', BY AMENDING SECTION TWENTY THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Prescribes a P30,000.00 as penalty for any violation of RA 4846, or imprisonment for not more than SIX (6) YEARS OR BOTH.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-07-27

first_reading.comm_act: change of ctte. ref'l from National Cultural Communitie s as per J.48;p.9

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE EXCAVATION OF STREETS AND/OR SIDEWALKS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Requires the immediate repair and replacement of any excavation WITHIN TWENTY-FOUR HOURS (24) from the time the work is started.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS OF PERSONNEL TO BE APPOINTED TO THE POSITIONS OF AGENTS AND SPECIAL AGENTS IN THE NATIONAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 2 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 2678,  AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to LOWER the educational qualifications for the position of NBI special agents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE AIR FORCE ACADEMY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Mandates the establishment in the Phil. Air Force of an educational institution to be known as the PHILIPPINE AIR FORCE ACADMEY for the instruction and preparation for military service of air force cadets. Prescribes the composition of the academicboard of the Academy, as well as the criteria for admission.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPROVING THE PROCEDURE FOR APPROVAL AND EFFECTIVITY OF LOCAL TAX ORDINANCES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION ONE HUNDRED EIGHTY SEVEN OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVEN THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED AND SIXTY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Declares that the State shall afford the public and the business sector a role in the enactment of local revenue measures through participation in the sanggunian hearings.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 185, ENTITLED 'AN ACT TO IMPLEMENT SECTION FIFTEEN OF ARTICLE XIV OF THE CONSTITUTION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES,' SO AS TO ALLOW NATURAL-BORN CITIZENS OF THE PHILIPPINES WHO HAVE LOST THEIR CITIZENSHIP TO BE TRANSFEREES OF LAND FOR RESIDENTIAL AND INVESTMENT PURPOSES, INCREASING THE AREA THAT THEY MAY ACQUIRE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Allows the transfer of land for residential , as well as investment purposes, and increases the area that may be acquired from [P1,000 square meters] of urban land and [1 hectare] of rural land to THREE THOUSAND (3,000) square meters of urban land and THREE (3) hectares of rural land.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING A SEPARATE SUBJECT ON ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION IN THE CURRICULA FOR SECONDARY AND COLLEGIATE LEVELS OF ALL SCHOOLS AND EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: States that NO new school or educational institution shall be established or allowed to operate UNLESS a separate subject on environmental education us included in the curriculum for secondary and collegiate levels.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A UNIFORM POLICY IN THE GRANT OF VISAS TO NATIONALS OF COUNTRIES MAINTAINING DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS WITH THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: States that "SECTION 1. Declaration of Policy ... No distribution as to form of government shall serve as a basis for the adoption of substantially different procedure in the grant or issuance thereof."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on FOREIGN AFFAIRS since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT FIXING THE RATES OF INTEREST AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: States that --- "SECTION 1. The rate of interest for the loan or renewal thereof or the forbearance of money. goods or credits, in the absence of any written contract as to such rate of interest, shall be six per centum (6%) per annum. The rate of interest allowed in judgments shall, likewise be six per centum (6%) per annum.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL FIFTEEN YEAR OLD PRIVATE VEHICLES FOR LAND TRANSPORTATION TO BE REGISTERED IN THE PROVINCIAL LAND TRANSPORTATION OFFICES AND ALL TEN YEAR OLD PUBLIC UTILITY VEHICLES  TO BE REGISTERED LIKEWISE AND FOR ALL TEN AND FIFTEEN YEAR OLD VEHICLES TO PLY ROUTES OUTSIDE OF THE URBAN AREAS

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE INTO THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE AND FISHERIES
